<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/outbox/{queueId}/retry"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Puts a message whose delivery failed for good back into the queue with a fresh set of delivery attempts. Only a failed message whose content is still stored can be retried: the content of the most recent failures is kept for this, within the bounds set by EENGINE_QUEUE_KEEP_FAILED_CONTENT and EENGINE_QUEUE_KEEP_FAILED_CONTENT_SIZE. A message that cannot be retried answers 409 with `code` NotFailed (the message is not in the failed state) or ContentGone (its content is no longer stored).
